scripts.build:css: cleancss -O2 --output assets/css/layout.min.css assets/css/layout.css && cleancss -O2 --output assets/css/main.min.css assets/css/main.css
scripts.build:js: terser assets/js/main.js --compress --mangle --output assets/js/main.min.js && javascript-obfuscator assets/js/main.min.js --output assets/js/main.min.js --compact true --identifier-names-generator hexadecimal --string-array true --string-array-threshold 0.75 --string-array-encoding base64 --string-array-wrappers-count 2 --self-defending true --numbers-to-expressions true --simplify true --control-flow-flattening false --dead-code-injection false --debug-protection false
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
